scope: controlled proxy-vs-native-Go-H3 streaming task; lab evidence only

design.model: fixed L2=1 logistic regression; train-only normalization; Newton solver
design.split: whole paired workload groups; heldout collected after training groups
design.uncertainty: 2000 paired-group bootstrap AUC; Wilson 95% TPR/FPR; does not establish 1% FPR operation
design.cost_denominator: validated HTTP body/download + received SSE payload; legacy helper checked SSE JSON/sequence only, new helper also verifies payload; excludes requests and inner syntax
design.line_scope: UDP payload; IPv4 estimate adds 28 bytes per actual datagram; no Ethernet/NIC headers
